title: 3.1.B1 Build-Up — Base Cube
description: Start the Spinning Sculpture: create a single yellow Cube at the origin with a black background.

steps.title: Create the base Cube
steps.instructions: In setup(), create `bigCube = new Cube(0, 0, 0)` and set its color to 'yellow'. Call `background('#000')` for a black scene.
hints: This is the foundation of the Spinning Sculpture — every build-up adds to this.

requirements.title: bigCube is a Cube
requirements.description: A new Cube is assigned to bigCube.
